name: Albrae-Don
description: Albrae-Don was a world in the Albrae-Don system in the Sern sector of the Colonies, in grid square L-13 of the Standard Galactic Grid. During the Imperial Era, Albrae-Don was a rebellious world along with other worlds in the Sern sector such as Ghorman.
lead_paragraphs: Albrae-Don was a world in the Albrae-Don system in the Sern sector of the Colonies, in grid square L-13 of the Standard Galactic Grid. During the Imperial Era, Albrae-Don was a rebellious world along with other worlds in the Sern sector such as Ghorman.
